column1: # clear: R. 15 Aug 1783, No. 3 (whole letter in cipher)

# reading: 500 parler 809. 914 (Thulemeier) est un infame. 446 (Hertzberg) sera(t) envo[y]er. 818 (le Roi) hait et meprise ... 724, mais en revanche il aime tendrement 734 ... et alors plus ... (sim)plement. Le tems me manque ... Potsdam ce huit d'aout ... roi.
# notes: rough first pass; inverted-T serves as o and d; end of line 2, middle/end of line 3 and line 4 not read
